# OpenTide Specifications

> Normative specification library for OpenTide. Not a documentation website.

## Governance

- GOVERNANCE.md: Change process (GitHub Issue → RFC → spec → opentide)
- AGENTS.md: Instructions for AI agents (tracking is public GitHub only; never Linear)
- Tracking: OpenTideHQ/specifications and OpenTideHQ/opentide issues. Never Linear.
- SPECS.md: Index of active spec versions
- rfcs/0001-authority-model.md: Authority model (spec → Pydantic → JSON Schema)

## Normative specs (specs/)

- specs/versioning.md
- specs/metadata.md
- specs/workspace.md
- specs/configuration.md
- specs/deployment.md
- specs/metaschema-keywords.md
- specs/platforms.md
- specs/validation.md

## Object specs (specs/objects/)

- specs/objects/threat-1.0.md (schema_id: threat::1.0)
- specs/objects/objective-1.0.md (schema_id: objective::1.0)
- specs/objects/rule-1.0.md (schema_id: rule::1.0)

## Vocabulary specs (specs/vocabularies/)

- specs/vocabularies/format.md
- specs/vocabularies/catalog.md

## Data

- vocabularies/*.vocab.toml: Canonical vocabulary TOML (36 files)
- schemas/vocabulary.schema.json: Vocabulary file JSON Schema
- schemas/inflight.shard.1.0.schema.json: Inflight preview shard envelope JSON Schema
- fixtures/valid/: Valid conformance YAML
- fixtures/invalid/: Invalid conformance YAML
- fixtures/cross-object/: Cross-reference conformance YAML
